proposed.text: What does Section 605.4 generally require for foundation plates, sills, and sleepers on concrete or masonry slabs in direct contact with earth?

options.text: Only a larger member size is required.
They shall be treated wood marked or branded by an approved agency.
They are outside the wood-protection section.

rationale.correct: Section 605.4 generally requires treated wood, marked or branded by an approved agency, for foundation plates, sills, and sleepers in the listed contact conditions.
rationale.takeaway: Section 605.4 is a treatment-and-marking rule for foundation wood in direct-contact conditions.
